rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] for t02-chinese-alias and t05-collection. The current cheat sheet omits E1-E4 (especially E4 alias-target-exists / alias-key-collision, critical for Chinese-name libraries) and W1-W4 (especially W1 orphan-entity, critical for collection libraries). The agent saw '0 warnings' and assumed success because it was unaware of rules the validator does not auto-flag. Adding the full rule set with pattern-specific callouts closes the coverage gap.
expected_effect: Agent will be aware of E4 (alias collision / missing-alias) and W1 (orphan entity) before treating '0 warnings' as success. For t02-chinese-alias, the agent will cross-check that every source name has an alias entry. For t05-collection, the agent will check that every extracted item entity is referenced by a stage.
regression_risk: Adding rows to the table increases cognitive load slightly. Existing passing tasks (t01-id-based, t03-multi-stage, t04-external-json) do not depend on the omitted rules being absent, so no regression expected.
